source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue the literature-driven Markov uniqueness plan. This submission formalizes the second half of Anitha Srinivasan's classical elementary prime-power result: uniqueness for positive ordered Markov triples whose common largest coordinate is twice a positive power of an odd prime. It combines the separately validated odd-prime-power collision split with the modulo-four pattern of positive Markov triples. When the common coordinate is even, the four complementary coordinates are all 1 modulo 4, making both collision factors divisible by 4. The selected collision factor is already divisible by p^(2k); because p is odd these divisibilities combine to c^2. A strict size bound forces that factor to vanish, and pairwise coprimality reconstructs the coordinate pair. This proves a known restricted family only and does not claim the full Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the exact Lean statement and authored the proof; the human did not author or materially edit the formal text. No claim of new mathematics is made.
